title: Man Wanted on Human Smuggling Warrant Arrested After Flock Camera Alert in Laredo
excerpt: A 35-year-old man wanted on a U.S. Marshals Service warrant for smuggling of persons was arrested Oct. 25 in Laredo after police responded to a Flock camera alert about a reported truck.
content:
A man wanted on a U.S. Marshals Service warrant for smuggling of persons was arrested in Laredo after police responded to a Flock camera alert, according to the Laredo Morning Times.

Jesus Valente Martinez, 35, was arrested at about 8:38 p.m. on Oct. 25, 2026, in the 2400 block of Louisiana Avenue in Laredo by the Laredo Police Department, according to the report.

Officers responded to a Flock camera alert involving a 2021 Ford F-150 that had been reported for unauthorized use of a motor vehicle, according to the report. The truck was recovered and returned to its owner, who later withdrew the unauthorized-use charge.

Martinez is charged with smuggling of persons, a third-degree felony, on the Marshals Service warrant, according to the report. He was booked into the Webb County Jail and released to another agency two days later.

The charge is an allegation, and the case has not been tried.

Sources: Laredo Morning Times.
